_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No Fed/CPI/jobs/expiry inside 24h, 30d change ~0%, funding neutral, and bottom analog still ~30pts away on momentum/funding — coil stays in Anxiety until a clear breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative offers no competing forward phase, analyst explicitly HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 25-40 and 30d momentum stays near flat with no funding flip or ETF-flow impulse through the weekend
next_move.invalidated_if: Fast >2% break with fear_greed leaving 25-40 — under 20 with funding negative (down a rung) or over 45 with ETF flows positive (up a rung)
